newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares seen staying firm on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares seen staying firm on Tuesday.

text.p: Buying sentiment was seen continuing for Singapore shares on Tuesday with the market set to consolidate gains made on Monday, dealers said.
"I'll be disappointed if there's no follow through from this," one dealer with an international brokerage said.
The Straits Times Industrials Index surged 35.27 points on Monday to end at 2,101.48, with the rise fuelled by a major U.S. fund buying programme.
"Second level interest has been piling in and that should continue," another dealer said, predicting blue chips would remain the main beneficiary of investor interest.
"The short term picture looks pretty good for Singapore," the dealer added.
